message.reasoning_content:
I will render the scene as a single JSON plan object.

The scene is Issue 1, scene 9 of 20, ST1. The player leans closer and brushes against the male character's shoulder. A departing witness murmurs that the wish found its own path without her price. This advances the A-plot by revealing possible outside intervention. Afterward, the fact that no witness has yet spoken of such involvement becomes true.

The protagonist faces an unresolved pressure: pursue the witness or question Julian about the murmur. The scene is first-person present tense in one physical location. Julian must have at least one meaningful moment. VisualState requires a concrete background. The ceiling is roughly 1000 words. No microDecision is used. is_consummate_scene is false.

The scene opens in the ritual clearing after the rite, where witnesses are departing. The player's shoulder-brush against Julian must be rendered as visible physical contact. The JSON plan will contain a concrete visualState and three to four phases within that single location.

The plan will use three to five panels. The shoulder-brush is a visible physical beat that triggers the witness's murmur. The penultimate beat names the dilemma, and the final beat resolves it.
